verdict.rationale: Jan's docs claim it can work on a task autonomously, handling files, commands and web research, and can run autonomous agents that manage calendars and act via WhatsApp, Discord or Slack (jan-docs-13, jan-docs-14). Browser automation via Jan Browser MCP adds some support (jan-docs-15). However, the MCP docs say each tool call must be approved individually in the chat (jan-docs-9), which cuts against unattended background operation, and nothing shows scheduled or triggered automations. Missing for 10: scheduling or trigger-based automations, documented unattended background execution without per-call approval, setup docs for persistent automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
